summary.text: Patty Acomb is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 45B and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Thomas Bergerson. A former Minnetonka City Council member with a natural resources background, she co-chairs the Climate and Energy Finance and Policy Committee.

paragraphs.text: Patty Acomb was born in and lives in Minnetonka, Minnesota, and graduated from Hopkins High School.
She earned a B.S. in natural resources from the University of Minnesota.
Ballotpedia says her career includes work for the Minnesota Department of Natural Resources in northwestern Minnesota and for Hennepin County environmental services.

Acomb served on the energy, environment and natural resources steering committee of the National League of Cities and on the board of the Minnesota Board of Water & Soil Resources, was appointed to a U.S. Environmental Protection Agency advisory committee, and was a member of the Minnetonka City Council.
She defeated Lorie Cousineau in the November 8, 2022, general election for District 45B.
For 2025-2026 she is co-chair of the Climate and Energy Finance and Policy Committee and serves on the Elections Finance and Policy and Ways and Means committees.
